authors_reviews.title: Works well except the sticking on the open and close on the slicker brush
authors_reviews.text: These worked fantastic. There is only one problem with the slicker brush in that sometimes it sticks a little when trying to close it to get the hair out. Thankfully my dog doesn't mind me brushing him and these just make it so much easier to do so. The only one of the 3 that seems to pull at the hair is the rake but it doesn't seem to bother my dog too much and it helps a lot with his shedding undercoat. They are all easy to clean, its easy to remove the hair from them when they have a build of of hair when I am brushing the dog.

authors_reviews.title: Strong performance across multiple coat types, with only very minor design quirks.
authors_reviews.text: I have been using this grooming set almost daily across two dogs and one cat, and it has worked really well for all three. One dog has silky fur, one has wirehair and hates being groomed, and my cat has a short but very dense coat, so this has been a good test of versatility.The undercoat rake works perfectly for quickly removing small knots and tangles on my wirehaired dog, especially around the back end, and it does so without much fuss from him. The slicker brush has been great for both my silky-coated dog and my cat. It removes loose fur well and the bristles are capped, so they are not scratchy or pokey on the skin.The handles are comfortable with a slightly squishy grip that makes them easy to hold during longer grooming sessions. The self-cleaning button on the slicker brush is also very convenient. It does feel like the button sticks just a tiny bit and could be smoother, but it still works and does a good job clearing the bristles.I have not used the bath brush yet, not because it seems useless, but simply because I do not need to bathe my dogs very often.Overall, this is a solid, useful grooming kit that has held up well with frequent use.

authors_reviews.title: Simple, Effective Grooming Kit That Gets the Job Done
authors_reviews.text: This 3-piece grooming kit works exactly as expected. The slicker brush, bath brush, and undercoat rake are all easy to use and comfortable to hold, thanks to the non-slip handles. They do a good job removing loose hair and keeping coats neat without causing discomfort. Cleanup is quick and easy, which is a big plus. Overall, it’s a solid, straightforward grooming set that works well for regular at-home grooming on both dogs and cats.

authors_reviews.title: Nice grooming set!
authors_reviews.text: My dog is half husky, half lab. He sheds like he gets paid by the pound. I've never had a double coated dog like this before so I'm new to undercoat grooming tools, this rake was the first one I've ever used. Wow! I thought I was doing a good job on keeping him brushed but this rake pulled out a good amount of fur. He seemed to enjoy it as well, he usually runs off when I try brushing him but he stayed put the whole time. I haven't used the bath brush yet, he's a pretty clean boy so we haven't bathed him yet, and the slicker brush is mostly for my cat. That's a cool brush too! The way the fur pops right off is nifty! I'm impressed with the rake and will get a lot of use out of 2 of these 3 items, lol. I'm very happy with it and do recommend.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

authors_reviews.title: Heavy-duty grooming set—perfect for different coat types!
authors_reviews.text: This 3-piece dog grooming set is high quality and has a nice weight to it, which leads me to believe it will be durable and hold up for a long time. I have two dogs with slightly different coats—one is thicker and more coarse, while the other has much thinner, finer fur. Having two different brush styles is perfect for our house, especially since they are both heavy shedders.I also really enjoy the bath brush. We use deshedding shampoo and conditioner, and the brush helps get the product deep into their coats to loosen up any fur stuck in the undercoat.My only complaint is that when you retract the brush teeth on the paddle brush, the "click" is fairly loud. This could be a bit difficult for dogs who are already nervous or don't want to sit still for grooming, as the sound might startle them. Aside from that, it's a great, sturdy set.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect grooming set
authors_reviews.text: This grooming set is surprisingly super high quality and very nice looking. I used it on my cats and they went crazy for it regardless of which tool I was using. The de-shedding brush is the only one that they can be a little over stimulated with, but it is so effective at getting the undercoat out and reducing shedding. My cats fur was so so soft after using the brush and de-shedder. The little silicone brush is also super handy for a quick pet and the cats love that as well. My favorite thing is the automatic hair removal function of the brush. You just press the button and all the hair goes in the trash. You don't have to spend time pulling it out of the bristles by hand.
